takeaway: Wallace's rule of nines: each arm 9 per cent, each leg 18 per cent, the back of the trunk 18 per cent, the face and head 9 per cent, the perineum 1 per cent.

question.text: Using Wallace's rules of nines, which of these burn descriptions gives the correct degree of burn?
question.say: Using Wallace's rules of nines, which of these burn descriptions gives the correct degree of burn?

answer.text: A man suffers full-thickness burns to the whole of his left arm. Degree of burns 9 per cent
answer.say: The answer: full-thickness burns to the whole of the left arm are nine per cent.

lines.text: Wallace the wizard counts in nines: the rule of 9s.
lines.say: Here is Wallace the wizard, counting in nines. This is the rule of nines.

lines.text: The whole left arm is burned: each arm is 9 per cent.
lines.say: This man has burns to the whole of his left arm. In Wallace's rules, each arm is nine per cent.

lines.text: The giant puzzle piece is a leg: each leg is 18 per cent.
lines.say: (laugh) And this giant puzzle piece is a leg. Each leg is eighteen per cent.

lines.text: Perineum 1 per cent, face and head 9, back of the trunk 18.
lines.say: Also remember: perineum one per cent, face and head nine, back of the trunk eighteen.

lines.text: Burns can release myoglobin, which may block the kidneys and raise potassium.
lines.say: A warning: burns can release myoglobin, which may block the renal tubules and cause hyperkalaemia.

lines.text: Remember: each arm is 9 per cent, each leg 18 per cent.
lines.say: Remember: each arm is nine per cent, and each leg is eighteen per cent.
